task_name: Collect Nails, Start Planks Production, Upgrade Three Homes, and Zone Two More Residential Areas

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When Nails finish at the Building Supplies Store and three residential zones/buildings show ready green-checkmark hard hats.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Upgrading three residential buildings in succession rapidly boosts population from 695 to 978 (including the first high-density apartment tower) and frees up two more Residential Zone slots.
preconditions: Wood, Metal, and Nails available in storage
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Queue Planks in the Building Supplies Store, upgrade the three ready homes, and place the two newly unlocked Residential Zones on the right end of the residential street.

steps.who: floating Nails on the Building Supplies Store

steps.briefing: drag Planks into the empty production slot.

steps.who: yellow hard hats on three ready residential buildings/zones
steps.briefing: drag Wood (2/1) & Nails (1/1) onto the first zone, Wood (1/1) & Metal (9/1) onto the left house, and Metal (8/4) onto the tall apartment building to upgrade all three.

steps.who: floating Wood on the northern Small Factory
steps.briefing: collect the Wood and drag Wood back into both slots.

steps.who: Residential Buildings icon on the right menu
steps.briefing: drag two new Residential Zones onto the right side of the residential street and confirm each with the green checkmark.
place one more Residential Zone at the far right of the residential street and click the green checkmark.
